SELECT m.* FROM message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT latest_by_time.conversation_id, MAX(latest_by_time.id) AS latest_id FROM message latest_by_time INNER JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}) AND status != 2 GROUP BY conversation_id ) latest_time ON latest_by_time.conversation_id = latest_time.conversation_id AND latest_by_time.create_time = latest_time.max_time WHERE (latest_by_time.from_user_id = #{userId} OR latest_by_time.to_user_id = #{userId}) AND latest_by_time.status != 2 GROUP BY latest_by_time.conversation_id ) latest ON m.id = latest.latest_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status != 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
